mapper.select: select src.id , src.rule_name as ruleName , bmc.cid , bmc.api_code as apiCode , case src.status when 1 then '开启' when 2 then '禁用' when 3 then '开启中' else '-' end as status , src.create_time as createTime , src.update_time as updateTime from b_score_rule_config src left join b_customer_rule bcr on src.id = bcr.rule_id left join b_marketing_customer bmc on bcr.customer_id = bmc.id
